body: Planning contract (2026-10-09): A1 save a complete new epic in the established planner, without changing the existing world-generation epic; A2 cover DD2-inspired light/heavy, guard/dodge, native weapon families and configurable LT abilities; A3 separate mounted loadout and complete new menus; A4 controller-first gameplay and UI, with keyboard/mouse parity; A5 cite primary engine evidence, label runtime unknowns and give executable probes; A6 dependency/acceptance coverage, independent review, durable saved readback. User confirmed planning only; free skill selection/slot arrangement (no ability-effect editor); player overhaul plus AI defense/reaction adaptation. No implementation/runtime success is claimed. Work: root owns epic authoring/integration and A1/A4/A6 (running); /root/combat_engine_research owns A5 primary-source investigation (running, read-only, notes at .darkmechanicus/local/combat-planning/engine-research.json); /root/combat_design_review owns A2/A3 coverage review (running, read-only, notes at .darkmechanicus/local/combat-planning/design-review.json). No worker may mutate planner or game/editor. Final verification will validate graph, ticket coverage, saved-plan equality and storage health. No execution run will start.
